name: Semera Beachfront Residences
pinSource: Developer website project page (karmadevelopers.com/projects/semera-beachfront-residences) embeds a Google Maps PLACE pin q=34.983184,34.017823 (a pin, not a camera position). Cross-checked: ~140 m from the Love Bridge sea arch (OSM 34.98255, 34.01647), matching the developer's aerial render ('Love Bridge 130 m') and the Google Map screenshot (site north of the coastal road east of Glyki Nero). High confidence. Plans give the land plot as 'Plot 131, Ayia Napa'.
amenities: Private infinity (vanishing) pool, 1.40 m deep, with wooden deck and outdoor shower
Basement with gym, laundry room, storage and covered parking
Optional roof garden (44.50 m² on the type B plan)
Home automation for lighting, A/C, blinds/curtains (brochure adds gates, sound system and cameras)
Electric underfloor heating on ground and first floor
CAT6 network provision in all rooms
facts: Semera is a scheme of three detached seafront villas (House A, B, C) on the coastal road east of Ayia Napa, beside the Ayia Napa Sculpture Park.
Plots range from 1,311 to 1,338 m²; the type B villa (price-list unit H02) sits on 1,324.84 m².
Villas are built on three levels: basement, ground floor and first floor.

Type B plan: basement 123.20 m² internal (gym, laundry, storage, parking) plus 155.55 m² covered outdoor area; ground floor 133.2 m² internal with a 68.5 m² covered veranda; first floor 150.8 m² internal with a master bedroom (en-suite, walk-in closet) and bedrooms 01-03; 54.40 m² uncovered outdoor area; total 685.65 m².
The type B villa has four bedrooms and five bathrooms plus a guest WC (presentation and price list).
Each villa has a private infinity pool; the brochure gives the pool as 48 m².
Specification: reinforced-concrete frame, 250 mm thermal clay-brick external walls with external insulation, part-clad in natural stone and Alucobond; A-class Energy Performance Certificate.
Equipment: VRV/ducted A/C, electric underfloor heating on ground and first floors, 5 kW PV, solar water heating (3 collectors, 250 L cylinder), EV-charger provision, CAT6 network, home automation.

The developer states: Glyki Nero Beach 500 m, Pantachou Beach 850 m, Sculpture Park 250 m, Love Bridge 130-150 m, Ayia Napa Harbour 1.2 km, Ayia Napa centre 1 km, Ayia Napa Marina 6 km (brochure) / 3 km (leaflet), Larnaca Airport 40 min (presentation) / 45 km (description).
Construction timeline on the developer website shows August 2025; status there is 'Under Construction', matching the price list (FRAMEWORK).
sources: SEMERA PRESENTATION UNBRANDED LQ.pdf (operator upload, 31 pp; same as share copy)
conflicts: Bedrooms: price list and presentation (House 2) say 4 bedrooms; the plans show master + bedrooms 01-03 (4). The description docx says '5' in Details and 'six bedroom villas' in the text; the leaflet says 'five bedroom villas'. Price list wins: 4.

Buildable area of the type B villa: price list and website 685.65 m²; presentation 'House 2 plans' says 658.70 m²; presentation key facts 499-658 m²; docx 504-614.20 m²; leaflet 505 m². Price list wins.
Plot range: docx 1,310.77-1,338.22 m²; leaflet 1,211-1,238 m² (looks like a typo); presentation/website 1,311-1,338 m².
Price list internal 284 m² = ground (133.2) + first floor (150.8) only; the plan also shows a 123.20 m² internal basement.
Status: docx and leaflet say 'Off-Plan'; website and price list say under construction (FRAMEWORK). Price list wins.

Flooring: brochure/docx/website say 'travertine marble floors'; the material presentation says 60x120 Italian ceramic tiles plus semi-solid parquet in bedrooms; the general technical specification says ceramic tiles up to EUR 50/m² everywhere incl. bedrooms. Travertine not used in our text.
Kitchen: docx/website 'designed by ARMANI DADA'; leaflet 'Kitchen design by Armani'; technical spec describes high-gloss MDF kitchen with porcelain worktop.

Distances: presentation says nearest beach 500 m but also '100 m away from ... beaches'; airport 40 min (presentation) vs 45 km (docx/leaflet); marina 6 km (presentation) vs 3 km (leaflet); shopping 700 m (docx) vs restaurants & shops 500 m / supermarkets 100 m (presentation).
Docx/website text says the main seaside road is 'only 100 metres from Nissi Residences' - copy-paste from another project; ignored.
Leaflet lists wine cellar, office space, maids room and entertainment room; not visible on the type B plans (which show gym, laundry, storage).
Spec says 'Provision for an EV Charging point will be installed' in standard and lists EV charger again under optional extras; underfloor heating is in standard and again under optional extras.
